text-align: left;"¦%%, }} | tablesortcol= 0 | order = descending }}__NOTOC__ == Description == Formatted and sortable table of vanquishable areas. === Usage === {{Vanquisher count
|campaign=
|region=
|beyond=
}} === Parameters === * '''campaign''' ''(optional, exclusive with region)'' - Prophecies, Factions, Nightfall, Eye of the North - only show explorable areas for this campaign. defaults to showing All if left blank. * '''region''' ''(optional, exclusive with campaign)'' - Ascalon, Kryta, Istan, etc. - only show explorable areas in this region. defaults to showing All if left blank. * '''beyond''' ''(optional)'' - Yes (include Beyond versions of areas in results, default), No (only show original versions of areas), Only (only show beyond versions of areas) === Examples === Using {{Vanquisher count|campaign=Factions|beyond=only}} creates {{Vanquisher count|campaign=Factions|beyond=only}} And using {{Vanquisher count|region=Kryta|beyond=no}} creates {{Vanquisher count|region=Kryta|beyond=no}} And using {{Vanquisher count|region=Ascalon|beyond=no}} creates {{Vanquisher count|region=Ascalon|beyond=no}}
